mentions.name: Timeline Translate
mentions.description: This app translates video or subtitle files into any other language, with a DaVinci Resolve plugin aimed at video editors, giving more control and ownership of the editorial process than other automated dubbing or subtitling tools.
mentions.audience: Video editors working in DaVinci Resolve; alternative automated dubbing/subtitling tools lack editorial control and ownership.
mentions.source_excerpt: Translate any video or subtitle file into any other language. Launched yesterday and geared towards video editors with a DaVinci Resolve plugin. Delivers more control and ownership of the editorial process compared to other automated dubbing or subtitling.
mentions.author: zimver
